title: Nestl Chaise Lounge Chair Outdoor Set of 2, Wicker Patio Lounge Chair, Outdoor Lounge Chair with Reclining Backrest
features: Chaise Lounge Chair, Outdoor Set of 2: Your outdoor sanctuary awaits with this outdoor lounge chair, perfect as a patio lounge chair or sunbathing lounge chair.

5 Adjustable Recline Positions: Enjoy supportive, ergonomic comfort with 5 reclining positions, from fully upright to fully flat, so you can socialize, read, snack, or nap on the patio chaise lounge chair.

Outdoor Chaise Lounge Set of 2: No assembly required for this pool lounge chair, just unfold the legs and enjoy straight out of the box. These patio chaise lounges are 26” W x 78.75” L x 38” H with 400 lbs weight capacity, and fold flat for compact storage.
Comfy Lounge Chair: Transform your deck, patio or pool with Nestl’s outside lounge chair. Create a comfortable, inviting outdoor seating area with a tanning lounge chair or sun lounge chair.
